name: chain_ct2s_cabk62_ur5e_enc2_pgc_m2c_yp_a-45_m2tc
arm_name: ur5e_enc2 with the PGC-140-50 housing as drawn by DH (round body, R19 #12) instead of the 75 mm box, mount m2: C2 wedge: same 26.6 deg tilt, the gripper on the inclined top face of a wedge bolted to the flange + cable, routing yp_a-45_m2tc
state: [carriage_x, base_y, base_yaw, q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, finger_l, finger_r] (m, m, rad, rad x6, m, m)
spline_coords: [carriage_x, q1..q6] (m, rad); the other state values are const_state of the piece
joint_convention: joint values are the sim joint coordinates (Menagerie UR5e / vendor URDF FR5), in the joint order q1..q6 = base / shoulder / elbow / wrist 1-3; zero and sign must match the controller at commissioning [E]

labels.unwrap: r19prep5_verify.unwrap (equivalent angle nearest the previous state, in range)
labels.approaches: each approach relabelled by the 2pi multiple nearest its play end (= r19hub.unwrapped)

certificate.checker: r19prep5_verify.py: Checker.check(full=True), MuJoCo contacts + GJK lower-bound certificate, 10 / 5 mm, joint ranges, food contact window (touch) on approaches
certificate.rule: every state fully checked; consecutive states <= 4 mm apart (point bound); joint-linear between the stored states (2pi-unwrapped)

fit_tolerance.rule: uniform: clip(RF x the certificate's minimum play reserve, TMIN, TMAX) (no per-state reserves stored)

stored_time_note: r17chain-style nominal time (unlimited acceleration: a constant speed per stored step) incl. dwells, grasp / release and approaches

sequence.name: grasp approach
sequence.contact: grasp approach: straight, 50.0 mm TCP (path 50.0 mm), empty gripper, jaws open

sequence.name: seat lift
sequence.contact: support contact window at the grasp (8.0 mm TCP; along the support normal): not a checked state, as r17chain / r19prep_verify

check.rule: support contact window at the grasp (8.0 mm TCP; along the support normal): not a checked state, as r17chain / r19prep_verify

sequence.name: pick (seated under the blade plate) -> raised 18 mm
sequence.contact: grasp / release piece of the play (straight, 10.0 mm TCP (path 10.0 mm), slow)

fit.kind: interpolating cubic (contact window: straight grasp / release piece)

range_excursion.note: max over the piece (0.2 mm grid in s) of the distance beyond the joint range / cart travel (m or rad)
max over the piece (0.2 mm grid in s) of the distance beyond the joint range / cart travel (m or rad)
max over the piece (0.2 mm grid in s) of the distance beyond the joint range / cart travel (m or rad)

sequence.name: slid in (18 mm) -> set down (8 mm)
sequence.contact: grasp / release piece of the play (straight, 10.0 mm TCP (path 10.0 mm), slow)

fit.kind: interpolating cubic (contact window: straight grasp / release piece)

range_excursion.note: max over the piece (0.2 mm grid in s) of the distance beyond the joint range / cart travel (m or rad)

sequence.name: set down
sequence.contact: support contact window at the release (8.0 mm TCP; along the support normal): not a checked state, as r17chain / r19prep_verify

check.rule: support contact window at the release (8.0 mm TCP; along the support normal): not a checked state, as r17chain / r19prep_verify

sequence.name: release retreat
sequence.contact: release retreat: straight, 50.6 mm TCP (path 58.0 mm), empty gripper, jaws open

time_law.method: r19stir2_law.timelaw per motion piece, rest to rest (closed-form TOPP-RA + r19smooth erosion / moving-average filter W + local slow-downs until every limit holds on the 2 ms grid) + TCP speed / rotation cap

sources.v_joint_free: arm datasheet (arms.speeds: UR5e 180 deg/s, FR5 180 deg/s) [S]
sources.j_joint: 14 rad/s^3: R19_SMOOTH rule "full acceleration in >= 0.1 s" [E] (no OEM joint jerk limit published for the UR5e)
sources.cart: 0.25 m/s (r17chain CW), 0.5 m/s^2 (R19_SMOOTH fastcart, sim tip-over model r19smooth_cart.py; quasi-static, GitHub #14 open), 5 m/s^3 (R19_SMOOTH assumption) [E]
sources.tcp: free: 0.25 m/s (ISO 10218-1 reduced speed = URScript movel default v) [S], rotation 90 deg/s (wok held: 45 deg/s, R15 pour physics) [E]; contact windows: R17 caps 0.10 m/s, 45 deg/s, joints 60 deg/s (r17chain VW/WW/QW) [E]
sources.W: 0.2 s moving-average window: filter jerk ~ 2 a / W stays at the jerk limits (R19_SMOOTH)
sources.holds: grasp / release 0.8 s each (r17chain GRASP), process dwells as the source set (r17chain / r19prepchain keyframes)
sources.not_in_law: jaw moment, food acceleration and cart tip-over are not re-evaluated by this law (R19_SMOOTH: non-binding at these caps)

playback.columns: t_s, carriage_x_m, base_y_m, base_yaw_rad, q1..q6_rad, finger_l_m, finger_r_m, element

pieces.name: pick (seated under the blade plate) -> raised 18 mm
slid in (18 mm) -> set down (8 mm)

state_fit.metric: global point bound (r19smooth.FastBound.g7, the bound on the displacement of every robot / held point) of the difference stored state - spline(parameter)

limits.method: np.gradient (central differences) of the 500 Hz samples, three times
